source.catalog: ISCAR Turning Catalog Part 1 (inch edition) - ISOTURN User Guide: Machining Data and Speed Recommendations for Turning
source.notes: Official ISCAR inch flipbook (index https://www.iscar.com/Catalogs/Publication/Catalogs_Inc/TURNING_Catalog/TURNING_CATALOG_PART_1_Flipview/index.html). Read from page image, row 11, column IC807/907: 230-427. No unit printed; ft/min established by ~3.28x ratio to the metric edition on other cells. The metric edition (Catalogs_Mm part 1, printed p.275, files/page/277.jpg) prints '70-30' for this cell, an apparent misprint, so it is not used and no metric value is recorded.
